notes: Shared parity fixture for classify_device_chat_intent (Python) and reviewableDeviceRequest (Console).
client_reviewable must never be true when server_intent is null (client must not be broader).

Intentional narrowing: server uses substring checks for coding verbs ("code" in text also matches "codex"/"coding"); the client uses word boundaries, so bare provider mentions or "coding" without an exact verb stay on ordinary chat.
Bare named providers in commands classify as coding on the server so Settings/from-chat can refuse clearly; questions about providers stay in ordinary chat.
